decisions.reason: The existing message-199 MODIFY already records the second V's proportional 2% elevation, restrained prominence, and subordinate visual role.
The client selects the 2% endpoint-height increase as the new Hero V baseline, replacing the prior set of percentage options.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Abdulbari,

This is exactly the type of study I was hoping for. Thank you for working through this with me. Isolating the height variable finally allowed me to evaluate what I was actually seeing in my mind.

I would like to move forward using the 2% increase as our new baseline. I think it gives the Hero V just the right amount of quiet elevation without becoming overstated.

Before we continue, I noticed a few elements that I believe were unintentionally unlocked during this study. These were previously established design rules that I'd like to restore.

1\. The É accent should be an exact copy of the Hero V's right arm terminal.

It shouldn't be reinterpreted independently. The Hero V remains the master geometry, and the accent should simply inherit that exact form.

2\. The peak of the É accent should terminate at the exact same height as the Hero V's right arm.

That relationship has become an important part of the visual language, so I'd like those two elements to align perfectly.

3\. The second V should remain much more restrained.

The second V should absolutely carry this same design language, but much more quietly. The percentage increase should be calculated relative to the second V's original height, not interpreted visually to match the Hero V. I would like its right arm to extend proportionally above the alphabet, yet remain almost imperceptible to the eye. Right now it has become too expressive. The second V should never compete with the Hero V—it should simply echo it.
For the next comparison, I think it would be very helpful to add three reference lines:

The current reference line showing the calibrated increase from the original baseline.
A reference line through the peak of the Hero V's right arm so I can immediately verify that the É accent aligns perfectly.
A reference line at the cap height of the rest of the alphabet so we can precisely refine how far above the alphabet the second V extends.

I think we're no longer searching for new ideas. We're refining relationships between the three signature elements that define the identity. Those relationships will become one of the subtle details that people never consciously notice, but instinctively recognize.

Thank you again. I genuinely feel like we're getting very close.

value_updates.right_endpoint_height_increase: 2% relative to the Hero V's original height
